description: Hermes-facing search via OmniRoute gateway. Omni UI owns Search providers and failover (Tavily → Firecrawl → SearXNG). Router Worker proxies with backend omni.
notes: Default backend omni → OmniRoute POST /v1/search (Bearer OMNIROUTER_API_KEY).
Per-provider timeout WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT_S (default 20s) so failover stays bounded.
Override WEB_BACKENDS=tavily,firecrawl,searxng for direct adapters when Omni is off.
Extract stays on Router Worker (SearXNG cannot extract).
